title: Encoded PowerShell execution from suspicious source
summary: Encoded PowerShell execution from suspicious source scored 100/100 and was routed to ESCALATE_TO_L2. Primary drivers: Source severity, Malicious IP match, Obfuscated PowerShell.

findings.label: Malicious IP match
findings.evidence: 203.0.113.66 matches the local malicious indicator list.

findings.label: Obfuscated PowerShell
findings.evidence: Command line contains encoded or in-memory execution indicators.

recommended_actions: Validate the alert time range and source telemetry.
Search the matched indicator across SIEM, EDR, DNS, proxy, and firewall telemetry.
Review the process tree, command line, parent process, and endpoint timeline.
Record findings and evidence in the incident ticket.
Escalate with the generated evidence package.
L2 to determine containment after validating business impact.
analyst_note: Automation provides decision support; a human analyst owns containment and closure.
